contract: Version-1 opaque-payload Envelope and shared delivery-result/error/attempt/deadline representation; no execution or payload validation.
limits: No transport, deadline scheduling, classification, retry execution or durable/ exactly-once guarantee.
IDs and schemas are declarations, not authenticity, matching, portability or payload certificates.

grounding.claim: Pinned Cure compilation checks the consumed pure record/decision source before emitting BEAM; not payload or foreign implementation validation.
Named positive/negative envelope scenarios, boundary translation and source audit; finite executable evidence, not a universal proof.
Relies on pinned Cure type checking, String/Option/Result/record erasure and structural equality; compiler soundness is not locally proved.
Callers keep identities, dispatch observations and schema declarations truthful, enforce ingress/resource limits, validate payloads and own runtime/Adapter semantics.

telemetry.contract: Pure declaration checks emit no observations. Invoking runtime/Adapter owns redaction, instrumentation and observer behavior.

config.contract: Intrinsic message/result fields are data; there are no ambient settings or selectable execution modes.

control.contract: No independent runtime lifecycle, dispatch or operational commands; control kind is data only.
